text: Welcome to MPD Industries' greenfield resin plant in Ujjain. Two plants, 22 reactors, around 6,900 tons of output every month. It starts with storage: two warehouses with mobile compact racking hold 2,904 pallets, about 1,500 tons. A depalletiser turns bagged raw materials into one-tonne jumbo bags for fast charging, and 600 KL of underground PESO tanks hold the solvents. In Plant 1, an overhead crane lifts each jumbo bag straight up to the reactor charging deck. Ten reactors up to 16 KL make saturated polyester, alkyds, and modified epoxy: 4,373 tons a month. Plant 2 adds specialty and solid resins, finished on flakers, pelletisers, and crushers. Polyamide, powder polyester, acrylic polyols, phenolics, and R&D scale-up: 2,530 tons a month. Every batch is released by our state-of-the-art QC lab, with a dedicated application lab that tests coatings the way your customers use them. Both plants are run from one central control room. Twelve blenders add 380 KL of blending, and 22 grade-dedicated tanks hold over 1,000 KL of finished goods. In total: about 1,500 tons of packed storage, and over 1,600 KL of bulk liquids. Utilities run green: agro-waste fired thermic heaters, fed from a covered fuel shed, and a 2,200 TR cooling tower. On-site nitrogen, a 50 KLD effluent treatment plant, and 0.7 MW of rooftop solar. Toll conversion, full-service jobwork, or dedicated capacity: partner with MPD Industries. Every model comes with NDA confidentiality, segregated storage, and a scale-up path from 2 KL trials to 16 KL production. MPD Industries. We innovate. We serve.
